analogy.rationale: IMPA1 inhibition depletes inositol and dampens phosphoinositide signaling, a metabolic effect that most cell lines tolerate with little transcriptional change; TSPO ligands and off-target sigma/P-gp interactions are the closest reference classes but share only weak downstream overlap.
